data_contract.task: within-prompt four-choice retrieval of one recorded demonstrator action
data_contract.candidate_policy: the four same-prompt episode actions at the same relative progress
data_contract.label_semantics: agreement with a recorded action; not success, safety, or optimality

training.normalization: feature-wise mean/std fit on train only; apply unchanged to development
training.loss: cross entropy over four shared candidate scores
training.checkpoint_selector: per-arm minimum development macro NLL; min_delta 1e-4

joint_stream_controls: permute video windows within exact prompt and progress
permute state windows within exact prompt and progress

limitations: Only 16 prompt groups per partition; uncertainty is large.
Prompt grouping does not establish physical-scene independence.
Recorded demonstrator action is not a unique semantic correct answer.
Development is project-created from publisher TRAIN and may guide this one bounded comparison.
